g.text: Can one MOLT redirect the web-weaving answer from 8 to 6?
Qwen3-4B · one layer and one position per trial · full donor contribution swap · attention unfrozen
Dotted line: ant-donor P(6). Other tested positions (have, ?) and all control trials are included in the report.
Interpretation: the strongest edit fails on held-out wording; 1 of 20 equal-norm random directions also gives >99.99% P(6).
